change_log.value: Schema and contract for specialty identification
Core logic for mapping input to NUCC codes

FEAT-2-S23.title: Define Specialty Identification Schema and Contracts
FEAT-2-S23.description: Define Pydantic models and internal contracts for specialty identification inputs and outputs, including normalized user query, expanded query terms, NUCC codes, and classification groupings.

FEAT-2-S24.title: Implement Core Specialty Mapping Logic
FEAT-2-S24.description: Implement dual-pipeline specialty identification logic combining regex extraction and vector similarity matching, including query expansion and NUCC code deduplication.

FEAT-2-S25.title: Expose Specialty Identification via Facade and Tool Router
FEAT-2-S25.description: Expose specialty identification capability through find_care_facade and register it with the tool_router for LLM tool-use, ensuring validated inputs and structured outputs.

FEAT-2-S26.title: Test Specialty Identification Accuracy and Edge Cases
FEAT-2-S26.description: Create unit tests covering common specialties, ambiguous inputs, multi-specialty queries, and failure cases to validate correct NUCC code mapping and deduplication.
